title: Merge an adapter into the weight
brief: Fold the low-rank update into the frozen weight, count the multiplies the unmerged adapter would add, and check that merged and split outputs agree.
hints: merge_lora is W + (alpha / r) * (B @ A). B is (d_out, r) and A is (r, d_in), so B @ A has the shape of W. A @ B is the wrong product.
extra_multiplies: x @ A.T costs r * d_in multiplies and (that) @ B.T costs d_out * r. Return the sum as a plain int.
merged_matches_split compares x @ merge_lora(...).T with lora_forward(...) and returns np.abs(difference).max() as a float. lora_forward is already written for you above.
